name: create_bucket
description: Creates a bucket in a project.

location.description: Optional. The location of the bucket. Object data for objects in the bucket resides in physical storage within this region. Region names are case-insensitive (e.g., 'us-central1', 'us'). Defaults to 'us' if not specified.

uniformBucketLevelAccess.description: Optional. If true, enables uniform bucket-level access on the bucket. When enabled, access checks only use bucket-level IAM policies, and Access Control Lists (ACLs) on individual objects are ignored.
